paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
suggested_experiment_name: unWISE Blue x Planck patchy screening
notes: Constraint on axion-photon coupling from resonant CMB photon-axion conversion (patchy screening) cross-correlated with unWISE galaxies. Paper states g_agamma < 2e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for 1e-13 eV < m_a < 1e-12 eV. This is an astrophysical/cosmological bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies.
